scenarios.title: Scenario 1: Cooperative Customer Pre-Qualification
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent greets caller as Vani from Darwix, systematically collects all 9 qualification fields, confirms details, and delivers an instant PRE_QUALIFIED underwriting decision.

turns.customer_text: Hello! My name is Michael Chang and my business is Horizon Tech Services LLC.
turns.agent_text: Understood. How long has your business been in operation?

turns.customer_text: We have been operating for 3 years and our average monthly revenue is $65,000.
turns.agent_text: Great. How much financing are you looking to secure today?

turns.customer_text: We are looking for $150,000 to invest in equipment upgrades and team expansion.
turns.agent_text: Understood. Do you currently carry any existing commercial business loans or debt balances?

turns.customer_text: We have no existing debt loans, and we are based in Austin, Texas.
turns.agent_text: Thank you, Michael Chang. Just to confirm all details: you are requesting $150,000 for Horizon Tech Services LLC, generating about $65,000 monthly for Equipment. Does that all sound accurate?

turns.customer_text: Yes, all those details are completely accurate.
turns.agent_text: Excellent news! Based on your 36 months in business and monthly revenue of $65,000, your business pre-qualifies for our Prime Commercial Term Loan. I will prepare your preliminary approval paperwork right away.

scenarios.title: Scenario 2: Objection Handling & Knowledge Base Inquiries
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent answers prepayment penalty FAQ and funding timeline FAQ with exact knowledge base citations, then seamlessly transitions to collecting qualification data and pre-qualifies the applicant.

loan_application.business_name: My Name Is Elena Rostova With Bluewave Logistics

turns.customer_text: Hi there, before I apply, are there any prepayment penalties if I pay off the loan early?
turns.agent_text: Yes. All Darwix Commercial Term Loans and Revolving Lines of Credit have zero prepayment penalties. In fact, borrowers who pay off their loan early often receive a discount on remaining interest charges or fee rebates. Could you please tell me your name and your business name?

turns.customer_text: And how fast can I get funded once I submit everything?
turns.agent_text: Initial qualification is instant over the phone. Official underwriting approvals are provided within 2 to 4 hours of document submission. Once loan contracts are e-signed, funds are wired via same-day ACH or direct wire transfer in as little as 24 to 48 hours. Could you please tell me your name and your business name?

turns.customer_text: That is wonderful. My name is Elena Rostova with BlueWave Logistics Corp.
turns.agent_text: Understood. How long has your business been in operation?

turns.customer_text: We do $80,000 monthly, in business 5 years, need $200,000 for fleet expansion in Seattle, Washington, no existing loans.
turns.agent_text: Thank you, Elena Rostova. Just to confirm all details: you are requesting $80,000 for My Name Is Elena Rostova With Bluewave Logistics, generating about $80,000 monthly for Expansion. Does that all sound accurate?

Excellent news! Based on your 60 months in business and monthly revenue of $80,000, your business pre-qualifies for our Prime Commercial Term Loan. I will prepare your preliminary approval paperwork right away.

scenarios.title: Scenario 3: Out-of-Scope Strict Fallback & Unrealistic Loan Leverage
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent strictly delivers non-hallucination fallback on cryptocurrency inquiry, detects excessive loan-to-revenue leverage ratio ($1.5M requested on $12k/mo revenue = 125x), flags conflict, and routes application to NEEDS_REVIEW.

turns.customer_text: Can I use this loan to invest in cryptocurrency tokens and Bitcoin mining?
turns.agent_text: I don't have reliable information about that at the moment. I can connect you with a human representative if you'd like.

turns.customer_text: Okay, I understand. My name is Daniel Price, company is Swift Retail LLC in Chicago, Illinois.
turns.agent_text: Understood. How long has your business been in operation?

turns.customer_text: We have been in business for 8 months and make about $12,000 monthly revenue.
turns.agent_text: Great. How much financing are you looking to secure today?

turns.customer_text: We want to borrow $1,500,000 for working capital.
turns.agent_text: I noticed a slight discrepancy: A requested loan of $1,500,000 is significantly higher than monthly revenue of $12,000 (over 125x monthly revenue). Could you please clarify which number is accurate for your records?
Great. How much financing are you looking to secure today?
